name: Deployment & Change Management
description: Change requests, risk, approvals, windows, pipelines, verification and rollback.

capabilities.name: CI/CD integrations
capabilities.summary: GitLab merge requests and a CI pipeline template.

capabilities.name: Change requests
capabilities.summary: Every infrastructure change is a tracked change request.

capabilities.name: Approval workflows
capabilities.summary: Auto-approve low-risk non-production; humans approve the rest.

capabilities.name: Risk classification
capabilities.summary: Low/medium/high from tier, operation and policy warnings.

capabilities.name: Pipeline execution
capabilities.summary: GitLab CI validate/plan/apply; production apply is manual.

capabilities.name: Rollback
capabilities.summary: Roll back to a previous stack version.

capabilities.name: Change history
capabilities.summary: Stack versions and change log per environment.

capabilities.name: Conflict detection
capabilities.summary: Concurrent edits to the same component are detected; one open MR per environment.
